svg.title: Three adaptive shots in one program
svg.desc: Timeline of the first 3 shots of track_t1 on D1's drive and readout lines and the controller link, with the long first wait cut short. Each shot plays a pi pulse, waits, and reads out; the outcome goes to update_t1, which answers within 500 ns plus the link's 4 and 8 ns, and a reset pulse plays only if the qubit read 1. The first wait is the 50 microseconds the call passes; each later wait is set by the answer, between 100 ns and 200 microseconds.
